key.name: daemon-url
key.description: Base URL of the usage-daemon that owns polling. Localhost only unless you know what you're doing.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: How often the extension re-reads the daemon snapshot. The daemon does the real (slower) polling; this is a cheap local read.

key.name: show-tier
key.summary: Show the tier badge in the panel

key.name: show-session-bar
key.summary: Show the Session usage bar in the panel

key.name: show-weekly-bar
key.summary: Show the Weekly usage bar in the panel

key.name: stack-panel-bars
key.summary: Stack the two bars vertically instead of side by side

key.name: show-bar-labels
key.summary: Show the S / W letter before each bar

key.name: warn-on-projected-depletion
key.summary: Blink a bar when the daemon projects it to deplete before reset
